subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

The farmers grow ________ in their fields.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'maize'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to a crop grown by farmers in a field, requiring a word that identifies a specific type of cereal grain.
 
• The word **"maze"** refers to a complex network of paths or passages; a labyrinth. (भूलभुलैया)
 
 
• **Example: **The children got lost in the garden maze.
 
 
 
• The word **"maize"** refers to a cereal plant that yields large grains set in rows on a cob; also known as corn. (मक्का)
 
 
• **Example: **The farmers harvested the maize just before the heavy rains started.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill the blank is **'maize'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **maize**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Mays** (ज़िया मेज़ - मक्का का वैज्ञानिक नाम का हिस्सा): While "Mays" is part of the botanical name for corn (*Zea mays*), it is not used in common English as a standalone noun for the crop.

 
 
• **Example:** *Zea mays* is the biological classification for corn.
 
 
 
• **Mase** (कोई मानक अर्थ नहीं): This is not a standard English word and is likely a misspelling or a distractor.

188:T932,

Here the correct answer is **Option 3.**
